summary.headline: Full-stack app: frontend (React) talks to a backend (FastAPI, Pydantic) backed by 3 tables (SQLAlchemy).

findings.text: Sorted 13 files by what they do, not where they live: 5 frontend, 1 gateway/middleware, 4 backend, 2 data, 1 worker, 0 shared.
4 client calls reach 4 backend handlers over HTTP.
3 tables and 4 schemas/DTOs; 2 schemas mirror a table; 4 functions touch the database.
3 UI elements are wired to handlers you can follow into the code.

libraries.name: FastAPI
libraries.explain: Python web API framework; routes are typed functions validated with Pydantic.

libraries.name: React
libraries.explain: Builds UIs from components; re-renders when state changes.

libraries.name: Celery
libraries.explain: Distributed task queue: workers pull jobs from a broker (Redis/RabbitMQ).
